sentences.text: Shri Sujoy Choudhary, Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Jayesh Yadav, Dy. G.A. for the non-applicant/Sta
 Shri Sharad Yadav, Advocate for the objector.
ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is third application filed under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C, 1973) for grant of bail during trial relating to FIR/Crime No.136/2024 dated (not mentioned), registered at Police Station Dwarkapuri, District Indore (MP) for the offence u/S 363, 376(3), 366 and 376(2)(n)
of IPC alongwith 5(l)/6 of the POCSO Act.
Applicant is in custody since 31.05.2024.
Applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 20.09.2024 passed in MCRC No.39080/2024.

His second bail application was dismissed on merit vide order dated 07.01.2025 passed in MCRC No.50411/2024.
2.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.
As per NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:12278 2 MCRC-20027-2025 prosecution case, prosecutrix is a major lady.
Earlier bail application was dismissed on the basis of DNA report.
However, applicant himself admitted the DNA report.
It is further submitted that statement of prosecutrix and her parents have been recorded before the Trial Court but they have not supported the case of prosecution and turned hostile.
Applicant is in custody since 31.05.2024 and has completed almost one year.
Conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and prayed for its rejection but fairly admits that prosecutrix and her parents have turned hostile and not supported the case of prosecution.
5. Learned counsel for the objector submits that he will file no objection with regard to grant of bail to the applicant during the course of the day.
6. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

7 . Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, rival submissions of counsel for the parties and custody period of the applicant so also no objection on behalf of the objector, this Court is of the view that it is a fit case to grant bail to the applicant.
hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

8 . It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:12278 3 MCRC-20027-2025 of the Trial Court for securing his/her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
9.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
10. With the aforesaid, this bail application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
